The change runs in <root>; read its code there. Edit only <root>/openspec/changes/002-stuck.
Done tasks stay done: none. Add a task for new work instead of rewriting a done one.
Run `osq lint 002` and fix every finding. A human runs `osq approve 002`, and the run continues from the first task that is not done.
